_about: Recorded model responses for the plate_ellipse convention. plate_ellipse is the gpt-4o response cached by the 12 Sep uncalibrated sweep (docs/evidence/2026-09-13-meal-replay/inputs/sweep_cache). width/height are the scan path's decode (EXIF-rotated, longest edge 1568). hough_rim_diameter_px is food_seg._plate_by_hough's circle on that decode: a SIZE only -- a Hough circle is round by construction and says nothing about tilt. Every bench photograph was shot top-down (bench protocol). No photo bytes: the frames show a live card with a name on it.
